title: Email to Doty about who wrote Serpo

tellings.quote: Dodie said, "I tip my hat off to you for realizing there was more people involved."

plain: In 2020 a researcher named Deep Prasad emailed Richard Doty, a former Air Force investigator, to ask who really wrote Project Serpo, a story about a secret exchange between the US and an alien world. Prasad tells Michels that he had worked out more than one person was behind it, and that Doty wrote back: "I tip my hat off to you for realizing there was more people involved." If that is so, the Serpo story was the work of a group, not one author.
